class: Any isolated agent worktree created from the orchestrator's LOCAL main starts from whatever that checkout last pulled; if merges landed on origin since, the agent builds on a stale base, misses files the work depends on (its own work item) and invents substitutes that conflict later.
mechanism: The main checkout was last pulled before PRs #31/#32; W-025's builder did not find work/W-025.md (added in #32), wrote its own with status in_progress, and the conflict surfaced only at rebase.

first_seen.evidence: builder report: 'work/W-025.md (created - the work item did not exist yet)'; git log showed base 60b326a = PR #31

fix: Orchestrator runs `git pull --ff-only` in the main checkout before every dispatch (board rule); builders rebase on origin/main before pushing.

detection.note: Habit only. A guard would be a PreToolUse hook on Agent dispatch comparing local main to origin/main, or the builder brief's first command asserting `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD`.

occurrences.evidence: both builders started from 60b326a; W-027 told to rebase before push
